theorems.name: Submission.fvmb_orthonormal_gram_sqrt_det_le_first_order
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (A ε : ℝ), 0 ≤ A → 0 < ε → ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧ ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, |t| < δ → ∀ B L : Euclid P →L[ℝ] Euclid P, ‖B‖ ≤ A → ‖L - ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (Euclid P) - t • B‖ ≤ η * |t| → ∀ τ : Fin n → Euclid P, Orthonormal ℝ τ → Real.sqrt (Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun i j => inner ℝ (L (τ i)) (L (τ j)))) ≤ 1 + t * ∑ a, inner ℝ (τ a) (B (τ a)) + ε * |t|
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
